rule: Operational Skills are reusable capabilities under existing Primary Brains. A Skill never becomes a Brain and never bypasses Tool Gateway or Owner Gate.

skills.title: Check Product Truth
skills.purpose: Verify supplier identity, product/variant truth, stock, price, shipping, media and market eligibility.

skills.title: Audit Supplier
skills.purpose: Verify official API/feed, terms, media rights, shipping support and supplier evidence before intake.

skills.title: Fill Shelf Candidate
skills.purpose: Find verified sellable candidates for a department gap without activating inventory.

skills.title: Build Feature Candidate
skills.purpose: Turn an approved product/UX brief into a code-change candidate with tests and evidence.

skills.title: Create Ad Candidate
skills.purpose: Create hook, concept, script and media candidate from verified Product Truth.

skills.title: Create Motion Candidate
skills.purpose: Create premium brand/product motion candidate while preserving locked visual references.

skills.title: Repair Incident
skills.purpose: Reproduce, find root cause, create minimal patch candidate, test, review and prepare rollback.

skills.title: Research Market
skills.purpose: Collect fresh market evidence and convert it into sourced opportunities or risks.

skills.title: Attribute Marketing Profit
skills.purpose: Join real order, finance, touchpoint and actual channel-cost evidence before claiming marketing net profit or CAC.

skills.title: Review Hourly Profit
skills.purpose: Read exact-VERIFIED hourly profit evidence, calculate the mission gap and propose next-hour actions without execution.

skills.title: Review Payment Launch Readiness
skills.purpose: Evaluate every HUNT payment route against commercial/account, sandbox, callback, refund, finance, settlement, country/currency, legal and Owner Gate evidence without activation.

skills.title: Review Checkout → Order → Tracking
skills.purpose: Prove checkout ownership, sandbox order, supplier order identity, persisted tracking and user-readable order state without live fulfillment.

skills.title: Review Market Legal / Returns / Shipping Readiness
skills.purpose: Gate each market using published business identity, legal documents, verified shipping promises, cancellation/return flow and market-specific review.

skills.title: Review Performance / Mobile Readiness
skills.purpose: Evaluate responsive integrity, homepage initial-render budgets, touch targets, critical browser failures and PWA update readiness.

skills.title: Review Launch Readiness
skills.purpose: Aggregate canonical domain gates and live non-sensitive launch metrics into one owner-facing report without changing any source gate.

skills.title: Refresh Product Truth Evidence
skills.purpose: Recheck CJ product identity, retail/profit gate, variant stock and destination shipping; write evidence observations only and preserve checkout recheck policy.

skills.title: Compile BDIF Decision
skills.purpose: Normalize a specialist/rule result into the canonical BDIF machine-readable decision contract without granting execution authority.

skills.title: Calibrate Decision Confidence
skills.purpose: Measure Brier score, calibration error and abstention quality from labeled historical decisions without changing live thresholds.

skills.title: Aggregate BDIF Judges
skills.purpose: Combine independent judges after hard policies and preserve disagreement as REVIEW/ESCALATE rather than hiding it.

skills.title: Simulate Business Scenario
skills.purpose: Run supplied optimistic/expected/pessimistic unit-economics sensitivities without claiming simulated contribution as realized profit.

skills.title: Evaluate BDIF Engine
skills.purpose: Compare Current HUNT, deterministic BDIF and model-assisted BDIF on the same held-out pilot cases before any production promotion.
